title: Zoho Desk Now Has Blended AI Agents: Turn Them On in 3 Steps #Shorts
description:
Zoho launched Blended Agents for Zoho Desk on 16 Nov 2026, powered by Zia Agents: AI retrieves information, executes tasks across connected apps and handles routine customer issues, while humans keep oversight. In Zoho Desk: Setup › User Management › Zia Agents › Prebuilt Agents, Agent Store, or New Agent (Agent Studio).

Zoho said it does not use customer data to train its AI models; in India Zoho Desk is hosted in local data centres.

Sources: newkerala.com (16 Nov 2026), zoho.com/desk/whatsnew.html, help.zoho.com 'What's new in Zoho Desk 2026'.

script.title: Zoho Desk Now Has Blended AI Agents: Turn Them On in 3 Steps #Shorts
script.hook_text: ZOHO DESK AI AGENTS ARE HERE

lines.say: Is your support team answering the same tickets all day? Zoho Desk now has AI agents for that.
lines.tts: Is your support team answering the same tickets all day? Zoho Desk now has AI agents for that.

lines.say: Routine questions pile up, your best people get stuck on easy tickets, and customers wait longer for real help.
lines.tts: Routine questions pile up, your best people get stuck on easy tickets, and customers wait longer for real help.

lines.say: Zoho just launched Blended AI agents in Desk: AI handles routine issues, while your team keeps human oversight.
lines.tts: Zoho just launched Blended AI agents in Desk: AI handles routine issues, while your team keeps human oversight.

screen.tip: AI handles routine tickets > humans stay in control

lines.say: First, open Setup in Zoho Desk, and click Zia Agents under User Management.
lines.tts: First, open Setup in Zoho Desk, and click Zia Agents under User Management.

lines.say: Next, open Prebuilt Agents to switch one on, or hire a specialist from the Agent Store.
lines.tts: Next, open Prebuilt Agents to switch one on, or hire a specialist from the Agent Store.

screen.tip: Zia Agents > Prebuilt Agents > Agent Store

lines.say: Or click New Agent to build your own in Agent Studio, with your own instructions and actions.
lines.tts: Or click New Agent to build your own in Agent Studio, with your own instructions and actions.

screen.tip: Zia Agents > New Agent > Agent Studio

lines.say: AI clears the routine work, your team takes the tricky cases, and Zoho says it never trains on your data.
